parameters.name: Bypass
parameters.description:
The bypass mode. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled

parameters.name: Fallback
parameters.description:
The back-to-origin on exception switch. When enabled, if the function encounters an exception such as CPU usage exceeding the limit, the request falls back to the origin server. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RouteEnable
parameters.description:
The route switch. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The Edge Routine timeout period. Valid values: 5 to 60. Unit: seconds.
